newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Wobbly Bunds to find crutch at 100.33.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Wobbly Bunds to find crutch at 100.33.

text.p: June Bund futures on LIFFE will look to support at 100.34 to rescue them from any significant downward move on Monday, technical analysts said.
"We are looking for it to chop around in a range," Robin Wilkin, senior technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch in London.
Wilkin said Thursday's low at 100.34 would provide the first buffer as the contract tried to claw its way up before a deeper correction.
Bunds were quoted at 100.53 at 0648 GMT, down 16 basis points from Friday.

"Nevertheless, the soft open is likely to set the tone for the week and strength to the top of the range should be sold as the increasing open interest that has accompanied the recent lower lows indicates the appetite of the market players to place new shorts," they said in a research note.
At the short end, September Euromarks were quoted at 96.73, unchanged from Friday's settlement.
